task.description:
Implement TNT-05, TNT-06, and TNT-07 per the design in src/design/tnt-05-07-backfill-export-cleanup.md.

TNT-05 - Backfill migration:
- Write migration SQL file: copies all rows from public.<business_table> WHERE tenant_id = T_uuid into tenant_<T_uuid>.<business_table> using ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
- Copies in dependency order per the design artefact
- Batches 10,000 rows per transaction
- Sets migration-window flag in public.onboarding_registry at start; clears at completion
- Creates and writes to public.tnt05_progress table for per-tenant progress tracking
- Writes orphan rows (unknown tenant_id) to public.tnt05_orphans
- Must be idempotent (safe to re-run)

TNT-06 - db_host column and export/import:
- Migration: ALTER TABLE public.tenant_schemas ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS db_host TEXT (defaults to NULL, meaning use BPM_DB_URL)
- Pool checkout: if tenant_schemas.db_host IS NOT NULL, open connection to that host; else use default pool connection
- Implement export CLI command or admin API endpoint: pg_dump tenant_<T_uuid> to self-contained dump
- Implement import procedure: pg_restore on target, UPDATE tenant_schemas SET db_host = <S2> WHERE tenant_id = T
- Implement MIGRATING status: tenant.status = 'MIGRATING' pauses writes (return 503); reads continue

TNT-07 - RLS cleanup migration:
- Pre-flight check: verify all tenants in public.tenant have public.tenant_schemas row with migrations_applied_at IS NOT NULL and public.tnt05_progress.status = 'COMPLETED'
- If pre-flight fails: abort with error listing unready tenants; zero DDL changes
- If pre-flight passes: DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, DROP POLICY (all policies from migration 028), DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS tenant_id for each business table in public
- DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.bpm_effective_tenant_id()
- Entire migration is idempotent (IF EXISTS guards)

Validation: zig build exits 0, zig build test exits 0, zig build migrate exits 0, no error-set output.
Commit to feature/WF02-tnt-batch2-20260609 and push.
acceptance_criteria: Backfill migration SQL file exists and is idempotent (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING)
Backfill copies in dependency order (definitions -> instances -> tasks -> tokens -> etc.)
public.tnt05_progress table created and per-tenant progress recorded
public.tnt05_orphans table created for unknown-tenant rows
Pool checkout routes to db_host server when set
Export/import procedure implemented (CLI command or admin API endpoint)
MIGRATING status pauses writes (503) while reads continue
TNT-07 migration: pre-flight check aborts if any tenant not ready
TNT-07 migration: DISABLE RLS, DROP POLICY, DROP COLUMN, DROP FUNCTION all use IF EXISTS
zig build exits 0 with no error-set output

result.summary: Implemented TNT-05, TNT-06, TNT-07 per src/design/tnt-05-07-backfill-export-cleanup.md. GBL-074 (tracking tables), GBL-075 (backfill algorithm with DELETE Phase 5b), GBL-076 (db_host column + MIGRATING status), GBL-077 (RLS cleanup with pre-flight gate). Added src/admin/tenant_migration.zig (export/import admin endpoints), src/api/middleware/tenant_status.zig (MIGRATING status check), pool.zig db_host routing (buildTenantDsn, resolveDbHostForTenant). All migrations applied to both dev and test DBs. zig build exits 0, no error-set issues.
